title: stolzia peperomioides subsp. thomensis

It is a succulent plant that has been traditionally used in East Timor to treat various health conditions, including fever, wounds, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Tomé Stolzia include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully elucidate its therapeutic potential.
